answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making reputation expensive to fake and impossible to copy. A new identity starts as a closed lotus bud, offering nothing until it opens through genuine verified work across many epochs. Each honest milestone is set in jade, a permanent record peers can inspect, while a gale of newly minted accounts has no history to show and simply blows past without gaining weight. Because voting strength is earned from attested tenure rather than wallet count, a farm that spins up ten thousand identities still holds the influence of one newcomer.
